chunks: And Isma'il ibn Muslim narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh, from his father, peace be upon them both, who said:

Allah, the Exalted, revealed to one of His prophets, peace be upon them: “With the generous, be generous; with the lenient, be lenient; with the stingy, be withholding; and in the presence of the harsh, be evasive.”

key_terms.الشَّكِسِ: the harsh, difficult, or ill-natured person
key_terms.الْكَرِيمِ: the generous person, one marked by nobility and giving
key_terms.فَالْتَوِ: so be evasive or indirect with him
key_terms.فَشَاحِحْ: so respond with restraint or withholding

ai.seo_question: How should a believer deal with generous, lenient, stingy, and harsh people according to hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches situational wisdom in dealing with people according to their character and manner. It presents a practical ethic of reciprocating appropriately in social and transactional conduct, especially with generosity, lenience, stinginess, and harshness.
